read.en: Rockwell Automation fell 0.4% on Nov 13 to $402.46, trading $398.33–408.60. It is above the 5-day ($399.9) and below the 10-day ($408.7), 30-day ($426.0), 100-day ($440.8) and 200-day ($426.6), all five falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($437.48), and RSI is 42.3.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月13日下跌 0.4%，收于 $402.46，盘中区间 $398.33–408.60。股价位于 5 日均线（$399.9）上方，10 日（$408.7）、30 日（$426.0）、100 日（$440.8）和 200 日均线（$426.6）下方，五条均线均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$437.48），RSI 为 42.3。

read.en: No level changed: the $408.6 high stalled at the 10-day again and the $398.33 low held the $397.5–401.8 band. Resistance is $406.9–412.7 (Sep 17 low, 10-day, Oct 15 low), then $426–426.6 (30 and 200-day) and $437.5–443.9 (SAR, Nov 4 close). Support is $397.5–401.8 (5-day, Nov 10 high, Nov 11–13 lows), then $392.5–394.1 and $383.1–388.4. A close above $412.7 would target $426; below $397.5, $392.5–394.1.
